values.description: Partner calls carry this service's own credentials, as configured for the named REST client. The only identity available to a deferred run, a subscription or a reclaimed attempt, and therefore the default. The report itself must do the narrowing: the partner sees one caller regardless of who asked.

Partner calls relay the requester's own access token, so the partner applies its own row-level scoping. Only possible while the run is on the request thread: a request whose estimate would defer it is refused, because the token is deliberately never stored. Requires the named REST client to be configured with auth.type: oauth2-token-relay, which the startup validator checks.

Stores finished reports under ludwig.export.sink.directory on this machine. Correct for a single instance; a multi-instance deployment needs a shared sink, because a download can only be served by the instance that produced the file.
UTF-8 with a byte-order mark, the delimiter taken from the request locale's list separator, CRLF line endings. What makes a Russian or German user's Excel split the columns correctly.
UTF-8 with no byte-order mark, comma delimiter, CRLF line endings, strict quoting. What a parser on the other end expects.
Office Open XML, written with Apache POI's streaming workbook.
